name: ca1-create-relight
refs: Our signed Create stage (project-owned), empty: the device housing, its dark inner wall, and the open tray in the middle. EDIT THIS IMAGE. Keep its exact framing, size and every edge.
Our signed concept frame (the Incubator): the light to match, one warm key light from the top left, a sheltered chamber with a lit floor.
prompt: Edit the first image only; keep its composition, perspective, housing, frame, screws, handles, the tray's sand-coloured rim and every outline exactly where they are. Repaint only the light and these three things: (1) one soft warm key light from the top left falling across the dark inner wall, brighter at the upper left and fading to the lower right, matte, as in the second image; (2) inside the tray (the open box in the middle), a real floor plane along its lower part, seen in gentle perspective, from about 45 px above the tray's bottom rim down to the rim, so something could stand on it; (3) a soft warm pool of light on that tray floor, centred on the tray, clearly the brightest area of the scene, falling off softly, never a hard spotlight or glow; (4) on the wall at the left, under where a pod would stand (left of the tray, about one fifth of the way across and a third of the way up from the bottom), a shallow worn oval dish pressed into the bench surface, lit by the same key light, empty. No creature, no objects, no text, no new hardware, no glow, no lens flare. Keep the bottom 54 px band as it is. Same painterly brush and materials as the first image.
